title: Convergence Rates for Latent Mixing Measures in Infinite Homoscedastic Location-Scale Mixture Models
summary: We study posterior contraction rates for mixing measures in homoscedastic location-scale mixture models with infinitely many components. While posterior convergence at the level of densities is well understood, ensuring convergence of the latent mixing measure is more challenging and has remained an open problem in settings where both location and scale parameters are unknown.
